chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman whom a man marries in mutʿah, and then he dies, whether she must observe the waiting period.
He said: “She observes a waiting period of four months and ten days; then if her days expire while he is alive, it is one and a half menstrual cycles, like what is required of a female slave.”

He said: I said, “Then does she observe mourning?” He said: “Yes. And if she remained with him for a day, or two days, or an hour of the day, then the waiting period has become obligatory, but she does not observe mourning.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَ عَشْرًا: the prescribed waiting period of four months and ten days in the case of the husband's death
key_terms.الْأَمَةِ: a female slave, whose ruling is used here for comparison
key_terms.الْعِدَّةُ: the legally required waiting period after separation or death
key_terms.تُحِدُّ: to observe mourning after the husband's death
key_terms.حَيْضَةٌ وَ نِصْفٌ: one and a half menstrual cycles as a waiting period

ai.seo_question: What is the ʿiddah of a woman in mutʿah if her husband dies or if the term ends while he is still alive?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings concerning the waiting period of a woman in mutʿah when the husband dies or when the term ends while he is still alive. It distinguishes between the ʿiddah of death and the ʿiddah after completion of the term, and it also addresses whether mourning applies.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4606 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a woman who entered into a Mut'ah (temporary marriage) and then her husband passed away.

Imam (as) said: "She must observe an 'Iddah (waiting period) of four months and ten days."
Then Imam (as) continued: "If her term ends while he is still alive, her waiting period is one and a half menstrual cycles, similar to what is required for a female slave."

I asked: "Does she need to observe mourning (Hadd)?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, but if she stayed with him for a day, two days, or even just an hour during the day, the waiting period becomes obligatory, but mourning (Hadd) is not required."
